instruction:
Rate the following short story on each dimension using a 1.0-10.0 scale, to at most one decimal place (e.g. 7.3). Use these anchors as a guide:
  1.0-2.9: very poor -- seriously flawed, hard to finish
  3.0-4.9: weak -- notable problems outweigh any strengths
  5.0-6.9: mixed/average -- real strengths and real weaknesses
  7.0-8.4: good -- clearly effective, only minor weaknesses
  8.5-10.0: excellent -- distinctive, executed with real skill
Use the full range and whatever decimal precision you think is warranted -- exact ties between stories are legitimate and expected when you have no reason to distinguish them further. Base your ratings on the text itself.

Respond with ONLY valid JSON in exactly this form:

{
  "plot_structure": 7.3,
  "prose_style": 7.3,
  "characterization": 7.3,
  "originality": 7.3,
  "overall_quality": 7.3
}
